description:
Outcome: Report a problem on an allocated plot; source: brief.md First version 4 and Constraints.
Scope: Plain-text report against own active plot; submitted confirmation only; no gardener report-history feed or attachments.
Excludes: online payments and tool lending; plot map excluded from first version and retained only in T-018.
Acceptance: Persist original plot, reporter, timestamp and open state; reject unallocated/foreign-plot submission; retries avoid duplicates. Stored reports coordinator-only; new plot holder cannot read former reports.
Behaviour: Preserve text after errors; clear accessible submitted/loading/error and unallocated guidance.
Verification: Phone reporting, ownership, direct-ID privacy, duplicate retry and no-allocation tests.
Prerequisites: T-005, T-008, T-003.
Assumptions: Approved setup assumptions: one household account; coordinator configures local timezone/application window; default occupancy March 1-October 31; returning means immediately prior season; initial final allocation after February 1 cutoff, advisory preferences and application order within groups; FIFO waiting list; no same-season reapplication after withdrawal/release; active holdings unique, history preserved; own active-plot reporting with coordinator-only report access; daily digest defaults to 08:00 local and skips empty days. No existing implementation. T-003 reviews provisional domain rules.
title: Report a problem on an allocated plot
